testCase.name: Manifest Permission Missing
testCase.description: SecurityException due to missing CAMERA permission

error.message: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA

agent_response.error: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA
agent_response.rootCause: The app requires the CAMERA permission to start an intent but the AndroidManifest.xml does not include this permission. The error occurs at line 5 of the manifest file, indicating that the missing permission declaration is causing a SecurityException during runtime.
fixGuidelines: 3. Re-run the app to check if it's granted the CAMERA permission at runtime.
4. Ensure that any other permissions required are also added in a similar manner.
5. If using API 23 or higher, add runtime permission handling code for CAMERA and other dangerous permissions.
